audit.why: Dr. Mundo wins 51.32% over 1208 games and the packet chart gives him the last stage; the side field has to state what the why already says.

audit.why: Her power is early through Level 6 (Grand Challenge at 110s rank 1) and the two-item HP timing is correctly named as the flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] and spikes[0].text claim Riposte stuns off Dr. Mundo's Q. Riot's text: Riposte's stab slows the first champion hit, and stuns only if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with it. Infected Bonesaw applies a slow, which is not an immobilizing effect — Dr. Mundo's kit has nothing that upgrades her parry to a stun. Also missing: Lunge applies on-hit effects, and both Duelist's Dance and Grand Challenge heal her.
audit.why: This changes the whole risk calculus — you can throw Q into Riposte and lose only the damage, never eat a stun, and the fight is decided by anti-heal rather than by armour.
audit.corrected: Riposte negates the bonesaw but cannot stun off it; Vital hits heal her and grant move speed; Grand Challenge heals her and nearby allies on completion; buy Grievous Wounds; Lunge applying on-hit means armour alone misreads the trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.early mentions Grievous Wounds but no content-layer field tells you when to buy it against the champion whose passive and ult both heal.
audit.why: Her sustain is what wins the extended duel, so anti-heal timing is the itemization decision that matters.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[2].text at the first-item timing.

edits.before: Only at full build does your health and R heal out-sustain her vitals.
edits.after: By two items your regen out-lasts her Vital healing — Dr. Mundo.

edits.before: Fiora bullies you the whole early game. Her W Riposte parries your Q Infected Bonesaw slow and can stun you, and her passive Duelist's Dance vitals shred your health-stacked bar with true damage. Never throw Q when Riposte is up, and don't stand still for her to proc vitals.
edits.after: Fiora bullies you the whole early game. Riposte (W) parries all damage on a 24s cooldown at rank 1, and it only stuns if it blocked an immobilizing effect — your bonesaw slow is not one, so it is merely negated. Every Vital she hits heals her and speeds her up: deny the angles.

edits.before: Even itemized, Fiora's vital true damage and Riposte outplay potential keep her ahead. Your Q sustain lets you survive lane, but you won't win a straight 1v1; use your ult to disengage rather than to duel.
edits.after: Even itemized her Vitals keep her ahead, and Lunge (Q) applies on-hit effects, so armour alone reads the trade wrong. Buy Grievous Wounds here: her passive and Grand Challenge both heal, and that healing is what carries her duel.

edits.before: At 6 her R Grand Challenge is her single best tool against you — four guaranteed vitals of true damage that your health pool does nothing against. Save R Maximum Dosage to heal through the initial burst, but don't expect to win the duel; survive it and reset with Q sustain.
edits.after: At 6 her R Grand Challenge is her single best tool against you — four Vitals of true damage that your health pool does nothing against, and hitting all four heals her and nearby allies. Press Maximum Dosage after her burst lands, then break the duel; Heart Zapper only heals you if its burst hits her.

edits.before: Riposte your Q slow to stun and negate it
edits.after: Riposte your bonesaw to negate the damage

edits.before: Proc Duelist's Dance vitals for true damage
edits.after: Hit Duelist's Dance Vitals to heal and speed up

notes: No mirror audit exists for fiora__drmundo yet — these findings should be reused from her side. Deliberately not asserted: the damage type of a passive Vital hit. Riot's text only says a Vital hit restores health and grants move speed; the trueDamage flag sits on Grand Challenge, so the page's claim that passive Vitals are true damage was left in place elsewhere rather than being extended. Also note the champion-wide error pattern: pages describe Blunt Force (E) as if it had CC and credit Infected Bonesaw (Q) with sustain — Q neither heals nor immobilizes.
